nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf of the UniswapExchange token; mutated with raw unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender]; written in approve and decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Whitelist mapping read in ensure to bypass sale restrictions.
Minimum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Max number of sales per address, set in init and enforced in condition.
Privileged trade address whitelisted in ensure, written by setTradeAddress.
Contract owner; the sole access-control anchor for delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure and pre-approved in the constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used to scale supply and sale limits.
Private _balances mapping of the inherited ERC20 implementation.
Private nested _allowances mapping of the inherited ERC20 implementation.
Private _totalSupply of the inherited ERC20 implementation.
Private _name string of ERC20Detailed.
Private _symbol string of ERC20Detailed.
Private _decimals of ERC20Detailed.
UniswapExchange.transfer: payable public transfer that immediately forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, the computed pair and tradeAddress, otherwise calls condition.
transferFrom: checks allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balanceOf/_onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
approve: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-first protection.
Internal view validating _saleNum/_onSaleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits for a sender.
Owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only initializer for _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; declared to return bool but returns nothing.
Owner-only batch airdrop that computes total = _value * _tos.length unchecked and mutates balances without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Internal pure CREATE2-style pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor: sets name/symbol/owner, mints supply and grants the UNI router uint(-1) allowance.
Inherited ERC20.transfer using _msgSender and SafeMath-backed _transfer.
Inherited ERC20.transferFrom; decrements allowance via SafeMath and re-approves.
Internal _transfer that moves _balances using SafeMath.
Internal _approve that writes _allowances.
Internal _mint increasing _totalSupply and _balances.
Internal _burn decreasing _balances and _totalSupply.
Public increaseAllowance using SafeMath.add and _approve.
Public decreaseAllowance using SafeMath.sub and _approve.
Context._msgSender returning msg.sender as address payable.
SafeMath.add with overflow require.
SafeMath.sub with underflow require.
SafeMath.mul with overflow require.
SafeMath.div with zero-divisor require.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer wrapping callOptionalReturn.
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom wrapping callOptionalReturn.
SafeERC20.safeApprove requiring zero-first allowance then callOptionalReturn.
Private helper performing a low-level call to an external token and decoding optional return data.
Address.isContract extcodehash check used to reject EOA token targets.
ATTENTION: untrusted_input msg.sender, the sole externally controlled actor in this contract.
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) executed in the token's storage context.

edges.reason: UniswapExchange.transfer forwards directly to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender becomes the implicit _from of transfer().
msg.sender is compared with _from and used to read/write allowance[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is used as spender in the inherited ERC20.transferFrom allowance path.
transferFrom gates execution through ensure(_from,_to,_value).
ensure falls back to condition() for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure treats owner as always allowed, bypassing all sale checks.
ensure compares _from against the UNI router constant whitelist.
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass of sale limits.
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address via pairFor.
condition checks _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition enforces the _minSale floor.
condition enforces the _maxSale ceiling.
condition reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw +/-.
Unchecked balance arithmetic can overflow/underflow the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
Unchecked allowance subtraction can underflow the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] accounting.
_from parameter flows into transferFrom balance and whitelist logic.
_to parameter flows into transferFrom balance crediting.
_value parameter flows into all transferFrom arithmetic.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall that can overwrite owner/state.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
msg.sender gating of the privileged delegate() entrypoint.
Caller-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall.
Caller-supplied calldata b is forwarded to the delegatecall.
init() reads msg.sender for its owner restriction.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before setting sale limits.
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled by 10**decimals into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled by 10**decimals into _maxSale.
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
batchSend reads msg.sender for its owner restriction and balance debit.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
_tos recipient array parameter drives the batch loop.
_value parameter drives credits, transfer amounts and the debit.
Overflowing multiplication result is stored in local total which is checked against balanceOf.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] with raw +/-.
batchSend emits Transfer events for _value/2, so credited value never equals value moved.
batchSend loop is driven by index i over _tos.length.
batchSend assigns _tos[i] to the local _to used for crediting.
Element of _tos flows into the local _to.
setTradeAddress reads msg.sender for its owner restriction.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress.
addr parameter becomes the new tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender and mints to the deployer.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals (onlySafeMath-free).
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
uint(-1) is written into allowance[msg.sender][UNI], enabling unlimited draining.
ERC20.transfer resolves the sender via _msgSender().
ERC20.transfer delegates state changes to _transfer.

ERC20.transferFrom moves balances via _transfer.

_transfer updates the _balances mapping using SafeMath.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
_mint increases the recipient _balances entry.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn decreases the holder _balances entry.

decreaseAllowance applies the new value through _approve.

decreaseAllowance relies on SafeMath.sub to prevent underflow.

safeTransferFrom encodes and executes via callOptionalReturn.

approve writes the allowance mapping without zero-first protection.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter is only meaningful as the sender argument of UniswapExchange.transferFrom and should be normalised into that function.
The _to parameter is only meaningful as the recipient argument of UniswapExchange.transferFrom.
The _value parameter only feeds transferFrom arithmetic and the ensure/condition gate.
The delegatecall target address is only relevant as the operand of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
The calldata bytes are only relevant as the operand of the unsafe delegatecall operation.
The _tos array is only used inside the batchSend loop and should be folded into batchSend.
The per-recipient _value only feeds batchSend arithmetic and events.
Local total = _value * _tos.length is an intermediate of the unchecked multiplication inside batchSend.
The _UNI pair address is a temporary computed by pairFor solely for the ensure whitelist comparison.
addr is only the value written to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init.
token is only scaled and assigned to _minSale inside init.
maxToken is only scaled and assigned to _maxSale inside init.
The loop index i is a purely local iteration variable of batchSend.
Local _to = _tos[i] is a temporary recipient reference used only within batchSend.
